name: Ruentex Engineering & Construction Co., Ltd.
summary: Ruentex Engineering & Construction Co., Ltd. engages in the construction and civil engineering contracting business in Taiwan. The company operates through the Construction, Construction Materials Business, and Interior Decoration Design segments. It engages in mechanical and electrical installation; water supply installation; refrigeration, and air conditioning; planning, design and consultancy for civil and precast engineering; import and export trade; distribution and agency of the building materials and equipment; and interior decoration design, construction, and garden greening design.
